subject.title: fix: restore trusted plugin subagent handoffs

question: Should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102168 become the canonical broad interactive/background authorization fix, or should this PR remain a separate narrower server-attested backend repair?
rationale: Both patches modify the same model-selection authorization boundary but encode different product and compatibility scope; automated review cannot safely choose whether the shipped background-only description should be widened for all interactive plugin calls.

options.title: Use the broader maintainer patch
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102168 canonical, incorporate any stronger attestation or HTTP tests from this PR, and close this PR after equivalent live boundary proof is available.

options.title: Keep the narrow backend repair
options.body: Land this PR only for server-attested nested/backend scopes and retain the documented background-only contract while separately deciding ordinary interactive behavior.

options.title: Consolidate into a replacement patch
options.body: Pause both PRs and produce one smaller owner-approved patch containing the chosen semantics, documentation, compatibility coverage, and current-head live proof.

recommendation.title: Use the broader maintainer patch
recommendation.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102168 canonical, incorporate any stronger attestation or HTTP tests from this PR, and close this PR after equivalent live boundary proof is available.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the canonical report and broader maintainer-owned implementation that explicitly analyzes the security and upgrade tradeoffs requiring this choice.
